subject.title: [Feature]: bearer token authentication for proxy servers

question: Which native mobile proxy-auth scope should OpenClaw support before Gateway auth: Basic/bearer/static headers in setup/manual config now, OIDC/cookie flows later, or only narrow per-platform Basic-auth slices?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent contract changes credential storage, setup-code payloads, WebSocket upgrade headers, and pre-Gateway authentication boundaries across mobile platforms.

options.title: Approve a shared static-header contract
options.body: Define setup/manual fields for Basic, bearer, and fixed headers across Android and iOS, with secure storage, redaction, reset, and TLS requirements.

options.title: Land narrow Basic-auth slices
options.body: Allow per-platform Basic-auth support first while explicitly leaving bearer, fixed headers, cookies, and OIDC as follow-up design work.

options.title: Pause for full proxy-auth design
options.body: Keep implementation PRs paused until maintainers decide the OIDC/browser-return and credential lifecycle model for every requested auth mode.

recommendation.title: Approve a shared static-header contract
recommendation.body: Define setup/manual fields for Basic, bearer, and fixed headers across Android and iOS, with secure storage, redaction, reset, and TLS requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history centers on setup-code bootstrap and gateway auth-selection contracts authored by steipete, which this feature would extend.
